name: ae-cfpb-complaint-benchmarking
what_it_holds: dbt/Snowflake project benchmarking consumer complaints across 10 major US banks using the full CFPB database (cited at 16.9M rows) sourced via BigQuery's public `bigquery-public-data.cfpb_complaints` dataset; pipeline code is committed, the 16.9M-row table itself lives on BigQuery (Google-hosted mirror of the CFPB DB, updated regularly).
why_useful: Confirms and documents the existing free, queryable BigQuery mirror of the full national CFPB complaint database (`bigquery-public-data.cfpb_complaints`) with a ready-made dbt transformation layer as a template; that BigQuery table is itself the more directly useful object (queryable with a free-tier GCP account, no scraping) for extracting BNPL-lender or travel/lodging-refund complaint slices.
time_coverage: CFPB DB inception (~2011) to present, refreshed periodically
license: unspecified pipeline code; underlying data is public-domain US government
themes: Consumer credit and BNPL: Klarna/Affirm public stats, Fed G.19, credit card delinquency, CFPB complaints dataset (Airbnb refund complaints), BBB complaint scrapers
why_all: Confirms and documents the existing free, queryable BigQuery mirror of the full national CFPB complaint database (`bigquery-public-data.cfpb_complaints`) with a ready-made dbt transformation layer as a template; that BigQuery table is itself the more directly useful object (queryable with a free-tier GCP account, no scraping) for extracting BNPL-lender or travel/lodging-refund complaint slices.

name: br_ibge_api
what_it_holds: Python client for IBGE's (Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics) open data API — consumes IBGE's 'Serviço de Dados' (municipality, geography, and statistical series endpoints). 7 stars, MIT, updated Jul 2025.
why_useful: Gives a one-command pull path for Brazilian macro/demographic series feeding gap #7 (Brazil IBGE regional travel/macro read for LatAm demand) and could support the ADR/nights regional-mix work for Brazil.
themes: Regional macro for LatAm and APAC: Mexico INEGI/Banxico, Brazil IBGE/BCB, Argentina INDEC, Colombia DANE, Chile, Japan e-Stat, Korea KOSIS, Australia ABS, India MOSPI clients
why_all: Gives a one-command pull path for Brazilian macro/demographic series feeding gap #7 (Brazil IBGE regional travel/macro read for LatAm demand) and could support the ADR/nights regional-mix work for Brazil.

name: estatapi
what_it_holds: R package client for Japan's e-Stat API (政府統計の総合窓口), the government statistics portal covering CPI, tourism, consumption, demographics. 23 stars, actively updated Mar 2026, listed on CRAN-adjacent ecosystem.
why_useful: Most mature/highest-starred e-Stat client found; enables pulling Japanese travel/consumption/CPI series for APAC regional macro read (gap #7), and Japan is a disclosed ABNB region proxy market.
time_coverage: full e-Stat catalogue (decades for many series)
themes: Regional macro for LatAm and APAC: Mexico INEGI/Banxico, Brazil IBGE/BCB, Argentina INDEC, Colombia DANE, Chile, Japan e-Stat, Korea KOSIS, Australia ABS, India MOSPI clients
why_all: Most mature/highest-starred e-Stat client found; enables pulling Japanese travel/consumption/CPI series for APAC regional macro read (gap #7), and Japan is a disclosed ABNB region proxy market.

name: estat-mcp
what_it_holds: e-Stat API client plus an MCP server wrapper for Japanese government statistics. 10 stars, Apache-2.0, updated 13 Sep 2026 (very fresh).
why_useful: Actively maintained alternative Japan macro-stats client; MCP wrapper means it could be plugged into an agent workflow for repeated e-Stat pulls (tourism/consumption nowcasting for APAC gap #7).
themes: Regional macro for LatAm and APAC: Mexico INEGI/Banxico, Brazil IBGE/BCB, Argentina INDEC, Colombia DANE, Chile, Japan e-Stat, Korea KOSIS, Australia ABS, India MOSPI clients
why_all: Actively maintained alternative Japan macro-stats client; MCP wrapper means it could be plugged into an agent workflow for repeated e-Stat pulls (tourism/consumption nowcasting for APAC gap #7).

name: korea-stats-mcp
what_it_holds: MCP server for querying Korea's KOSIS (Korean Statistical Information Service) national statistics in natural language; published as npm package @kimdayoun/korea-stats-mcp. 16 stars, MIT, updated 10 Sep 2026.
why_useful: Most-starred, freshest KOSIS client found; gives programmatic access to Korean tourism/consumption/employment/housing series for APAC regional macro (gap #7).
themes: Regional macro for LatAm and APAC: Mexico INEGI/Banxico, Brazil IBGE/BCB, Argentina INDEC, Colombia DANE, Chile, Japan e-Stat, Korea KOSIS, Australia ABS, India MOSPI clients
